scope: Anonymous official product pages and their published tariff scope. No customer sign-in, account data, transaction or security bypass. This is bounded research evidence, not proof that every possible source has been exhausted.

observations.finding: The product pages describe customer-requested instant quotes and channel differences. The retrieved public page provides no retail USD/HKD buy/sell table. A maximum bank spread of 300 points does not identify a current customer rate.
observations.dataDecision: Keep the exact SC China retail buy/sell evidence gap; do not use another bank or a hypothetical maximum spread as its price. Continue source research without asking the user to collect it.

observations.finding: The actual public asset is generic utilities and did not supply an anonymous FX quote endpoint. Opaque security resources were not used.
Currency Conversion describes a market order in Client Portal and IBKR Mobile. It is a product demonstration, not a public HKD/USD or CNH/USD retail bid/ask feed.
observations.dataDecision: Keep known conversion commission separate from the missing executed spread. The tool page does not prove spread is zero.

observations.finding: The current free transfer rows cover domestic counter and electronic interbank transfers. No SGJGR001 personal international-remittance waiver is published in this table. Domestic transfer footnotes still mention regional policies.
observations.dataDecision: Do not use the domestic OTO waiver to fill the international remittance tariff gap. The page's 2020 URL and 2015 footer do not establish offer age; the current offer text explicitly ends in 2026.

observations.finding: The point-to-point and onward remittance description enumerates foreign currencies and regional electronic-channel availability. The companion electronic banking cross-border page describes FX remittances. These descriptions do not resolve the ordinary personal mainland-to-Hong-Kong CNY tariff.
observations.dataDecision: Preserve the already verified foreign-currency mobile group fee waiver, and keep the ordinary CNY tariff evidence separate.
